descriptions.w3d_d24h_find_movie_800c6100: Movie category lookup: selects the 12-byte record table for the TV format (0x80304de0; table 0x803f5728 for format 1, 0x803f58b4 for 0 and 2, panic at line 300 otherwise), scans until an empty name or category 29, and returns the category of the record whose name compares equal, or 29.
